A '''battle''' was fought between the forces of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Treuten Teradoc]]'s [[Greater Maldrood]] at [[Togoria/Legends|Togoria]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. During their advance towards the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and campaigns against the warlords of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], New Republic forces moved from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to strike Teradoc's people at his [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] [[Togoria/Legends|Togoria]], checking the warlord's ambitions, though with costly results. However, the [[Thanos system]] stayed in the Greater Maldrood. It was definitely [[Battle of Thanos|liberated]] [[8 ABY/Legends|three years later]], during the [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|Post-Zsinj campaign]].<ref name="TEA" /> After this battle, the [[New Republic Third Fleet|New Republic Third Battle Group]] fought its way to [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]] where it linked up with [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum's]] defense force and established a beachhead on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].<ref name="Warfare" />
